title: A Sharper Certified Lower Bound for Erdos' Minimum-Overlap Problem
description:
Proof note, frozen dual certificate, and two interval-arithmetic verification paths for the computer-assisted lower bound c_E > 0.38056070 for Erdos' minimum-overlap constant.

The proof retains Liam Price's certified Arb bounds for 170 noncentral mean bins and replaces the two binding center bins. The new center proof object uses the exact second-moment row, ordinary Fourier rows, exact harmonic rows, and a fixed weighted Parseval row -sum w_n C_(n*pi) <= 1/2 with 0 <= w_n <= 1. The underlying Parseval energy inequality is not new; the improvement comes from the optimized non-rectangular spectral window inside Price's mean-conditioned certificate framework.

The frozen center certificate is checked by two separate implementations developed within this project: a standalone direct-MPFR/C verifier with directed rounding and sixth-order Taylor enclosures, and an independent mpmath.iv verifier with a separate implementation and subdivision strategy. This is not an external third-party audit. The LP/frequency search used to discover the certificate is outside the trusted proof path.
